meta.title: A negative quantity in the vendor's quantity column is refused
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ so the vendor receives a pricing sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product to create a vendor quantity row.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor required for the vendor-portal test.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ pricing sheet as the vendor.
Attempt the invalid negative offered quantity and require positive refusal evidence.
Verify that no submitted bid state was created after the refusal.
